statement: Let D/L be a non-CM elliptic curve over a CM number field. Suppose that a regular algebraic cuspidal representation π realizes H1(D) at one coefficient prime. Then π has weight zero and trivial central character, realizes H1(D) at every coefficient prime and every coefficient isomorphism, and satisfies ι WD H1 (D, Ql)|GLv F-ss ≃ recT Lv (πv) (v ∤ l). If D has potentially multiplicative reduction at v | l, then π is ι-ordinary of weight zero there.
